criteria_evidence.usability: Extremely user-friendly interface. Visual spectrogram feedback is intuitive and engaging.
criteria_evidence.generation_speed: Fast generation but not quite as rapid as MusicGen. Acceptable for creative work.
criteria_evidence.audio_quality: Audio quality is variable. Some artifacts and inconsistent fidelity across generations.
criteria_evidence.stylistic_accuracy: Style matching is inconsistent. Works better for some genres than others.
criteria_evidence.parameter_control: Very limited parameter control. Minimal ability to fine-tune outputs.
criteria_evidence.content_generation_control: Limited control over musical content. Outputs can be unpredictable.
criteria_evidence.daw_integration: Basic file export available. No advanced integration features.
criteria_evidence.creative_workflow: Visual interface encourages experimentation. Good for exploratory creative work.

strengths: Excellent usability with innovative visual interface
Accessible to users without technical background
weaknesses: Limited stylistic accuracy for many genres
overall_assessment.recommendations: Best for creative exploration and generating unexpected ideas. Not recommended for production work requiring consistent quality. Ideal for experimentation and inspiration.
